spots.name: Hidden Zen
spots.blurb: You've reached Hidden Zen, a mural by Penny Bohn from 2018. Plaque: "Through the intricate and colorful design of the zentangle-style artwork, Bohn encourages engagement and interaction with this mural.... Give it a pull!... a playful reflection of the vibrant nature of Daybreak neighborhood.".
